sources.name: actions-se
sources.scope: opt-in Union A SE stationary actions; exact historical Gettysburg v6/v7 only
sources.annotationMethod: Separate model-assisted source review; manual torso/pelvis X and row-shared ground Y approximately +/-5 to 8 native pixels, muzzle +/-3 to 4. One 495px stationary reference across all actions; cap/sole spans are diagnostics, never per-frame normalization.
limitations: Representative simplified two-state loading, not a verified full historical drill or exact weapon model.
Firing barrel axis is approximately31degrees down-right under the SE camera; geometry and cheek/grips are visually plausible, not human-anatomical or rig certification.
Native imagegen corrections changed details outside requested translation. No exact12px translation or source identity preservation is claimed.
Very faint colored RGB and alpha1 boundary residue remain; measured blue residue is below alpha8. Padding gate is alpha64, not every nonzero alpha.
Single held fire pose does not provide recoil/settling; melee, casualties and dedicated color bearers remain accepted-art fallback.
Production/full-family approval and independent human/historical validation remain false.
